networks.comment: The only network in this example — the dockside container and any devtainers it launches all share it (Dockside must reach each devtainer directly on this network to reverse-proxy to it). dockside_mac is required, not optional: without it, the ING chain drops all new intra-network connections, including the dockside container's own connections to devtainers, breaking the reverse proxy. dockside_egress is left at its default, "exempt", so the rules in firewall-config.json end up governing devtainer egress only, not the dockside container's own traffic — switching it to "policed" would require first writing rules here covering everything the dockside container itself needs to send/receive (DNS, ACME, etc.).
networks.name: dockside
